messages:
alex: Quick ping — PR #3129 (kv cache naming) is ready for final pass. Main change: rename `CacheKey` -> `KVCacheKey` and a tiny formatter exemption in `runtime/kv.go`. PTAL when you have a sec.

maria: on it, leaving a quick pass now. Is there a test that covers the key serialization?

alex: yes, added `kv_test.go:TestKeyRoundtrip` — small table test. I ran it locally.

sam: quick heads-up, the formatter exception looks like `gofumpt` wants a reflow on the struct tags. can you paste the snippet?

alex: here:
```go
type CacheEntry struct {
    Key KVCacheKey `json:"k"`
    Val []byte
}
```
I tried to keep the tag short for perf reasons in wire format.

jen: hmm, tags shortness makes sense, but CI is failing on `gofumpt` formatting. Two options: add an exemption comment for the file or change formatting to pass CI. Which do you prefer?

alex: prefer exemption for now — it's noisy to reformat generated-matching wire structs. I added `// gofumpt: skip` at top, but CI bot flagged it. Maybe the linter needs a different pragma.

ci-bot: lint/gofumpt failed on `runtime/kv.go` — see https://ci.internal/12345 for details

maria: simplest short-term: wrap the struct in a `// keep-short-tags` comment that the linter maps to allow-list. I can add it and re-run. Otherwise, sgtm for exemption policy but want a consistent tag.

sam: another nit: `KVCacheKey` name is fine, but file-level godoc uses `CacheKey` in examples — update docs to match.

alex: thanks — I'll push doc update + the allow-list comment. Will request re-run. Anyone object to merging after CI green and 1 more approver?

jen: no objections. @maria could you re-approve after CI? :thumbsup:

maria: yep, will re-approve once CI passes.

ci-bot: build passed on re-run — https://ci.internal/12345/build/678

maria: approved — LGTM

alex: merging now. thanks all :tada:
